titleZh: 休息一下，注意力也需要留白

cet4.title: Small Breaks, Better Focus
cet4.summary: 坐在书桌前很久并不一定学得多。消息和多个网页会分散注意力，让人反复读同一段，座位上的时间无法完整代表有效思考。

paragraphs.text: A student sits at a desk for a whole afternoon but finishes very little. Messages appear, several tabs remain open, and the same paragraph is read again and again. The problem may not be a lack of effort. Attention has become scattered. Staying in a chair for a long time is easy to measure, but it does not necessarily show how much useful thinking has taken place.
paragraphs.translation: 坐在书桌前很久并不一定学得多。消息和多个网页会分散注意力，让人反复读同一段，座位上的时间无法完整代表有效思考。

paragraphs.text: A more manageable approach begins with a small, clear task. Instead of planning to study everything, the student chooses one article and decides what to understand. Unnecessary tabs are closed and the phone is moved away. The goal is not to create perfect silence. It is to reduce the number of competing demands so that returning to the task requires less effort.
paragraphs.translation: 先设定小而清晰的目标，例如理解一篇文章，而不是一次学完所有内容。减少无关网页、把手机放远，可以降低竞争性的注意力需求。

paragraphs.text: Short breaks can make the plan easier to maintain. After a focused period, a person might stand up, stretch or look outside. A break is an opportunity to change activity, rather than simply replace one stream of information with another. Scrolling through messages may leave attention just as busy as before. Different people need different routines, so the length of a useful work period will vary.
paragraphs.translation: 专注后短暂起身、伸展或看看窗外，有助于形成可持续的安排。刷消息可能继续让注意力忙碌，不同人的适宜节奏也不相同。

paragraphs.text: At the end of a session, a simple check is more helpful than counting minutes alone. Can the student explain the main idea without looking at the page? Can an unfamiliar word be recalled in a new sentence? These questions connect study time with understanding. A sustainable routine includes both effort and recovery. It aims to make tomorrow's learning possible, rather than turn one afternoon into a test of endurance.
paragraphs.translation: 学习结束应检查能否脱离原文解释主旨、回忆词汇，而非只数分钟。好的节奏包含努力与恢复，使第二天仍有条件继续学习。

paragraphs.text: A learner might begin tomorrow by writing one sentence about the next task. This small preparation reduces uncertainty at the start of the session. When it is time to stop, leaving a clear note about where to continue can have the same effect. Returning to learning becomes easier when the next step is already understandable.
paragraphs.translation: 提前写明下一项任务，结束时留下继续的位置，可以减少重新开始的不确定性，让学习更容易衔接。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指注意力被消息和多个任务分散，难以集中于阅读。

examples.text: Her attention was scattered by the constant noise outside.
examples.translation: 外面持续的噪声分散了她的注意力。

examples.text: With so many tasks open, his thoughts became scattered.
examples.translation: 同时摆着这么多任务，他的思绪变得分散了。

focusWords.meaning: 可持续的；能够长期维持的
focusWords.contextMeaning: 指包含努力与恢复、能够长期坚持的学习习惯。

examples.text: A sustainable study plan leaves enough time for rest.
examples.translation: 可长期坚持的学习计划会留出足够的休息时间。

examples.text: Working late every night is not a sustainable routine for her.
examples.translation: 每晚工作到很晚对她来说不是一种能长期维持的习惯。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指长时间坚持学习所考验的耐力；文章认为学习不应只比谁撑得久。

examples.text: The long walk tested our endurance.
examples.translation: 这次长途步行考验了我们的耐力。

examples.text: The task required patience and endurance rather than speed.
examples.translation: 这项任务需要耐心和耐力，而不是速度。

questions.prompt: Why is time at a desk an incomplete measure of learning?
options: It does not show whether attention was focused.
It always proves complete understanding.
It prevents all interruptions automatically.
It shows exactly how much every person remembers.
questions.explanation: 时长不等于注意力质量或实际理解。

questions.prompt: Which study objective is the most manageable?
options: Learn everything about every subject today.
Keep every browser tab open all afternoon.
Remain seated without checking understanding.
Identify the main argument of one article.
questions.explanation: 清晰、具体的小目标更容易执行和检验。

questions.prompt: What may prevent a break from providing a useful change?
options: Looking away from the screen.
Changing to an activity with different demands.
Continuing to follow a stream of notifications.
Standing up for a short time.
questions.explanation: 继续刷通知可能延续原先的碎片化注意模式。

questions.prompt: What does the author suggest about study schedules?
options: Never change them when comprehension weakens.
Adapt them to the learner and the task.
Use exactly the same timetable for everyone.
Judge them only by how strict they appear.
questions.explanation: 不同任务与个人条件需要不同节奏。

questions.prompt: Which action best checks the result of studying?
options: Explain an idea without looking at the text.
Count the number of tabs on a screen.
Record only how long the chair was occupied.
Open another unrelated notification.
questions.explanation: 主动回忆与解释比单纯计时更能反映理解。

cet6.title: Attention Is a Resource That Needs Deliberate Care
cet6.summary: 坐在书桌前很久并不一定学得多。消息和多个网页会分散注意力，让人反复读同一段，座位上的时间无法完整代表有效思考。

paragraphs.text: Time spent at a desk is an appealing measure of commitment because it is visible and easy to count. Yet it provides an incomplete account of learning. A student may remain seated for hours while repeatedly shifting between messages, unfinished tasks and a difficult paragraph. The resulting fatigue can be mistaken for evidence of productive effort. A more useful approach treats attention as a limited resource whose quality depends on the conditions under which it is used.
paragraphs.translation: 学习时长容易观察，却不能完整反映学习质量。频繁切换任务可能造成疲劳，但疲劳并不等于有效产出；注意力的使用条件同样重要。

paragraphs.text: One of those conditions is the clarity of the task. An instruction to study an entire subject creates many possible starting points and few clear signs of completion. A narrower objective, such as identifying an article's argument and supporting evidence, offers a more manageable structure. Removing unnecessary tabs or placing a phone out of reach can further reduce competition for attention. These arrangements do not eliminate every interruption, but they make it easier to recover the thread of an activity when an interruption occurs.
paragraphs.translation: 任务清晰度影响专注。明确文章论点与证据等具体目标，比学习整个科目更容易执行；减少干扰也能降低被打断后恢复思路的成本。

paragraphs.text: Recovery also deserves an explicit place in the routine. A brief change of activity may offer relief from the demands of sustained reading or problem solving. Standing, stretching or looking at a distant view creates a different experience from continuing to consume rapidly changing information. A break filled with notifications can preserve the same fragmented pattern that made studying difficult. The important distinction is therefore not simply between work and leisure, but between activities that place similar or different demands on attention.
paragraphs.translation: 恢复应成为计划的一部分。起身、伸展等与持续阅读需求不同的活动，有别于继续接收碎片化信息，后者可能延续注意力分散。

paragraphs.text: No single timetable should be treated as ideal for everyone. The appropriate balance depends on the task, the person's circumstances and how demanding the material is. A familiar exercise may require a different rhythm from an unfamiliar argument. Instead of following a schedule mechanically, learners can observe when their comprehension begins to weaken and adjust the routine. Such adjustment should support sustained engagement rather than become another source of pressure or self-criticism.
paragraphs.translation: 没有适合所有人的时间表。任务难度与个人条件不同，学习者应观察理解何时下降并调整节奏，避免机械执行造成额外压力。

paragraphs.text: Finally, the outcome needs to be checked through something more informative than duration. Explaining a concept without notes, answering a question or recalling vocabulary provides evidence of what has been understood. These small tests can reveal where further work is needed while giving a focused session a meaningful endpoint. Effective study combines purposeful effort with opportunities to recover. Its ambition is consistent learning over time, not the longest possible performance of being busy on a particular day.
paragraphs.translation: 效果应通过脱稿解释、答题与回忆来检查。这些小测试能揭示困难并形成有意义的结束点，目标是长期持续学习，而不是表现得忙碌。

paragraphs.text: Preparation can make transitions easier as well. Writing a short note about the next question to address gives a later session a clear starting point. At the end of work, recording the remaining uncertainty can preserve a thread that would otherwise have to be reconstructed. These small actions reduce the effort of beginning again. They connect separate periods of attention without requiring uninterrupted concentration or treating a necessary break as a failure of commitment.
paragraphs.translation: 简短记录下一问题与未解决之处，能保留思路、降低再次开始的成本。这连接了不同专注时段，而无需把休息视为不够投入。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指不断被通知打断、缺少连续性的注意力模式。

examples.text: Frequent interruptions left her working day fragmented.
examples.translation: 频繁的打断让她的工作日变得碎片化。

examples.text: His fragmented attention made it difficult to follow the argument.
examples.translation: 他的注意力支离破碎，很难跟上论证。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指读者对材料的理解程度，可据此判断是否需要调整学习节奏。

examples.text: The teacher checked comprehension with a short discussion.
examples.translation: 老师通过简短讨论检查理解情况。

examples.text: Slowing down improved my comprehension of the difficult passage.
examples.translation: 放慢速度提高了我对这篇难文章的理解程度。

focusWords.contextMeaning: 指中断后重新梳理原有思路，学习笔记可以减少这项工作。

examples.text: She reconstructed the argument from a few notes.
examples.translation: 她根据几条笔记还原了论证思路。

examples.text: Without a record, the sequence of decisions had to be reconstructed later.
examples.translation: 由于没有记录，后来只好重新梳理决策的先后过程。
